Dana Kovalenko

Head of snail care

Dana started the farm with her brother in 2021, with 400 snails in two beds behind the house. Today she looks after nine beds and about 9,000 snails, and she writes about the seasons: when the snails wake, what they eat in a dry July, and how we put them to bed in November.

12 November 2026, five minutes to read

The snails have gone to sleep for the winter

Below 8 °C the snails seal their shells with a white lid and stop eating. We carried the last beds into the barn on Monday, and the farm stays quiet until March.
